open_points.subject: refusal reason size handling
open_points.text: A20: “Over a ceiling is always a refusal or a failure, never a truncation — for code, values, files, requests, responses and outputs. The one exception is `failure_detail`”; State 5: “A refusal's reason is at most `bounded_text_bytes_max`, cut at a UTF-8 character boundary.”
open_points.question: Is a refusal reason allowed to be truncated, or must its construction fail or use another bounded representation when it exceeds the ceiling?
options: Truncate refusal reasons as State 5 says
Never truncate them because `failure_detail` is the sole exception
Require reasons to be intrinsically bounded so truncation never occurs
open_points.default_guess: Truncate refusal reasons according to the more specific State 5 rule.

open_points.subject: runs.resume_run observable effect
open_points.text: “Observable effect: Elements waiting on an unreachable service are sent again.” But its Enforces rule says authority is checked again, and A14 says an element whose grant was revoked “waits for approval instead”; a pre-send check may also fail before sending.
open_points.question: Does `resume_run` guarantee an HTTP send for every `service_unreachable` element, or only reach/re-evaluate each element, some of which may wait or fail without being sent?
options: Reach and re-evaluate every such element; sending is conditional
Guarantee a send for every such element
Stop processing remaining elements when one cannot be sent
open_points.default_guess: Reach and re-evaluate every such element in order, with sending conditional on current authority and pre-send checks.

open_points.subject: many-file port references across runs and effects
open_points.text: A13 says “a file list is the elements' SpooledFiles in element order, each keeping its own record, and the reference naming it carries the list's class” and that an empty list is named with its class, while `effects.reach_operation_element` accepts inputs only as “StoredValues and SpooledFiles” and M23 names file outputs only through SpooledFile facts.
open_points.question: What object or facts represent a `many` file value—including its aggregate disclosure class, especially when the list is empty—when it is stored in a NodeExecution and passed from `runs` to `effects`?
options: A distinct file-list reference containing ordered SpooledFile identities and a disclosure class
An ordered list of SpooledFiles plus a separate per-port disclosure class
Derive the class from element records and, for an empty list, from the producing node's inputs
open_points.default_guess: Use an explicit per-port file-list reference containing the ordered file identities and the aggregate disclosure class.
